Subset of Noto Sans Devanagari Regular (static TrueType).
Source: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-fonts/blob/main/hinted/ttf/NotoSansDevanagari/NotoSansDevanagari-Regular.ttf
Source SHA-256: 385e78e6359a9d88a0f243d53b1209d7548361ba2194e2b9ec779bcaa7e8949d

fontTools 4.66.1 subset retains U+0038 and U+0915 and name IDs
0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 13, 14, with recalcTimestamp=False.
Name IDs 1, 3, 4, 6 are renamed to MacropadDevanagariTest.
The resulting font contains three glyphs and is test-only.
It exercises cold non-Latin style initialization, retry after allocator
failure, and pinned bitmap lifetime without requiring fontTools at test time.
